metadata.description: Dolle developer toolkit — command-gated skill packs, agents, and hooks for AI-assisted development.

plugins.name: devkit
plugins.description: Command-gated skill packs for subagent-driven development, LangChain agents, LangGraph workflows, documentation, UI/UX design (via the bundled Dolle-MCP server), web performance, UI design craft (anti-slop, fundamentals, page shape, type & color, surfaces, design systems), native/desktop GUI design (Qt/GTK), prompt enhancement (clarify with AskUserQuestion, then sharpen), app prompt engineering (idea → build-ready spec), and shipping to platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (CI/CD & IaC). Packs load only when you call their command, keeping startup context minimal.
